A hook that waited on the shared rust-script cache completed in 80.733 seconds wall but only 5.821664 aggregate CPU seconds; no timeout or memory limit was widened. Final composition retains current result-writer ownership and ambiguity checks. The new compared_outputs field also needs a current-report parser refusal when verdict is no_result; three consuming checks otherwise omit that contradiction. This is completion of the new field's contract, not a proven earlier base-versus-head regression. Retained historical parsing remains unchanged.

Independent read-only mapping of https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/2694 confirms the two remaining mechanisms are still present on current main. The private alias/raw-status fix 046139e3affc6548054befe809f76fdafcb6846a does not discharge them. SaBre's pinned RemoteReverieAdapter::handle_thread_start returns unit and logs Err or Pending before allowing guest execution to continue; its file is byte-identical between the old and current Reverie pins. A failed inherited-descriptor initialization therefore needs actual backend-owned termination and cleanup. DBT's real fork reconstructs the child from copied process-local state, and exec has no surviving fd-to-OpenFileId/status transfer; status changes are not shared across real processes by a process-local Arc. Its preserved status-transaction design already identifies shared authority, incarnation-bound bindings, physical-effect completion and timely last-alias cleanup as the coherent repair. No runtime was executed and neither outstanding finding has been cleared.

Queue recovery audit is complete enough to sequence existing work.
